description: Structured input a user fills in describing their legacy environment for assessment

environment_summary.description: Free-text description of the current-state environment (systems, platforms, known pain points)
environment_summary.example: 65 SharePoint on-prem sites with active Nintex workflows, migrating to AEM. Government client, multi-agency access controls.

app_count.description: Number of applications, sites, or discrete systems in scope

data_volume_estimate.description: Rough size/scale of data or content to migrate

integration_complexity.description: Degree of cross-system dependency (APIs, workflows, auth integrations)

team_size.description: Number of engineers/consultants available for the migration
